reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web UI plugin that adds a right-side navigator for user messages with previews, reading-position tracking, keyboard navigation, and click-to-jump history loading.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加用户消息侧边导航条，支持预览、阅读位置跟踪、键盘操作和点击跳转。
summaries.en: Adds a right-side user-message navigator to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with previews, reading-position tracking, keyboard controls, and click-to-jump navigation.

capabilities: Indexes user messages in the current conversation
Displays local message previews and reading position
Loads earlier conversation history for navigation
Modifies the Web UI with a navigation panel
